what: What did each Lunenburg town employee earn in 1970?
why: `report-gross-wages` holds per-employee earnings from the 1995-2010 reports and FY2011-FY2025. The 1970 annual town report prints no wage list: the whole text (136 pages) was searched for wage, gross, salary and payroll and found only aggregates (the accountant's wage lines in the schedule, p39-50; `Payroll Deductions`, p38), the Personnel Committee's note on the Salary Administration Plan (p20) and the School Personnel Listing (p105-116), which names staff, education and years of experience and prints no pay (sources/data/report-tables/1970/). — closes: the Town's calendar-1970 payroll register (W-2 totals by employee) from the Treasurer's office.

what: What were the town's ADOPTED non-union salary grades and step rates in 1970?
why: `salary-schedule` and `report-classification-plan` read Schedule A from the 2010 report and FY2011 onward. The 1970 report prints a PROPOSED schedule for March 6, 1971 (p21, landed as `report-proposed-salary-schedule`), and only the vote that adopted the schedule `voted on March 7, 1970` is reported (p68, the Article amending Article 1 of the by-laws); the schedule then in force is not printed. Searched classification, salary schedule, grade and step (sources/data/report-tables/1970/). — closes: the Personnel Board's Classification and Salary Schedule as adopted March 7, 1970.

what: What did each special revenue fund take in, spend and carry forward in 1970, town-wide?
why: `special-revenue-funds` holds forward, receipts, disbursements and balance by fund from the 1995-2010 reports. The 1970 report prints the revolving funds' YEAR-END balances only, as lines of the balance sheet (p28 `Revolving Funds`: School Lunch 6,223.01, School Athletics 288.59), the school lunch and athletic accounts inside the School Department's own report (p124, p130), and revenue lines in the Treasurer's receipts (p31-34); no town-wide receipts-and-disbursements schedule by fund. Searched special revenue and revolving: the only hit is p28 (sources/data/report-tables/1970/). — closes: the Town Accountant's calendar-1970 special revenue fund ledger.

what: What was appropriated, spent and carried forward on each capital project fund in 1970?
why: `report-capital-projects` holds a separate capital project fund schedule from the 2001-2010 reports. The 1970 report prints no such schedule: the accountant's schedule lists each special article with its balance (p39-50), the balance sheet carries the unexpended appropriation balances (p28-29), and no capital plan is printed; so whether any project sat in a separate fund is not shown. Searched capital project, capital plan and capital improvement: no hit (sources/data/report-tables/1970/). — closes: the Town Accountant's calendar-1970 capital projects fund ledger.

what: What was Lunenburg's assessed valuation by property class, its levy, overlay and new growth for 1970?
why: `report-valuation` holds the valuation and levy history from the 1987-2010 reports. The 1970 report prints the assessed valuation as lines of the opening facts page (p3: real estate $48,359,830, personal property $1,195,950, tax rate $33.00), in the running text of the Assessors' page, and no recapitulation of the levy, the overlay or growth. The overlay appears only as a reserve and a funding source (p28-29, p69-70). Searched valuation, overlay, tax rate, levy and growth (sources/data/report-tables/1970/). — closes: the Assessors' 1970 tax rate recapitulation (the Tax Recap sheet filed with the State).

what: How many weighing and measuring devices did the Sealer test in 1970, and what did sealing bring in by device?
why: `report-weights-measures` holds the Sealer's device counts and `sealing-fee-schedule` the fee per device from the 2001-2010 reports. The 1970 report gives the year's totals in prose on p63 (124 devices inspected, 121 found correct and sealed, one pump and two scales condemned) and the Treasurer's receipts one line, `Inspector of Weights & Measures` $303.10 (p33 of the PDF), with no count or fee by device type. Searched weights and measures, sealer, sealing (sources/data/report-tables/1970/). — closes: the Inspector of Weights and Measures' 1970 test and fee record.
